summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) has become the de facto standard for connecting AI agents to external tools, data, and APIs via a uniform interface, replacing bespoke per-tool integrations. By 2026 the ecosystem spans hosted remote servers from major vendors (GitHub, Vercel, Linear, Notion, Supabase, Stripe, Figma), aggregator marketplaces, and gateways that secure and route MCP traffic. This matters because MCP lets any AI assistant discover and invoke real-world capabilities—running tests, editing repos, querying databases—without custom glue code.
ecosystem_note: Individual MCP servers expose one product's tools (e.g., GitHub or Playwright), aggregators are marketplaces/platforms that bundle and manage hundreds of servers through one integration, and gateways/proxies sit in front of servers to handle auth, routing, rate limiting, and observability.

tools.name: GitHub MCP Server
tools.connects_to: GitHub repos, issues, pull requests, Actions, code search and file operations for AI-driven development workflows
tools.pricing_paid: Included with GitHub plans; usage governed by existing GitHub subscription tiers
strengths: OAuth-secured hosted remote endpoint (2026 default)
First-party support and deep repo automation
Ubiquitous in Cursor, Claude, and IDE agent setups
tools.best_for: Automating code review, repo management, and CI workflows from an AI coding assistant

tools.name: Playwright MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Headless and headed browsers for navigation, scraping, form filling, and end-to-end UI test automation
strengths: Lets agents control real browsers deterministically
Accessibility-tree based automation (no vision model required)
Widely recommended for Cursor agent workflows
tools.best_for: Browser automation and automated web testing driven by AI agents

tools.name: Composio
tools.connects_to: 250+ apps and tools (Slack, GitHub, Gmail, Notion, Linear, etc.) with managed auth and a unified MCP layer
tools.pricing_paid: Paid plans scale by active connections/tool calls; team and enterprise tiers available
strengths: Managed OAuth and credential handling across hundreds of integrations
Single integration surface for many servers
Strong agent framework support and documentation
tools.best_for: Teams that want one platform to give agents authenticated access to many SaaS tools

tools.name: Cloudflare MCP (Remote MCP / AI Gateway)
tools.connects_to: Hosted/remote MCP servers with OAuth, edge deployment, and routing/observability for agent traffic
tools.pricing_paid: Workers/AI Gateway paid tiers based on usage and requests
strengths: Deploy and host remote MCP servers at the edge
Built-in OAuth and security primitives
Scalable, low-latency global infrastructure
tools.best_for: Deploying secure, scalable remote MCP servers and gatewaying agent requests

tools.name: Figma MCP Server (Dev Mode MCP)
tools.connects_to: Figma design files, components, and Dev Mode data so agents can generate code from designs
tools.pricing_paid: Requires Figma Dev Mode seat; included in paid Figma plans
strengths: OAuth-secured hosted endpoint (2026)
Design-to-code context directly in the IDE
First-party, accurate design token extraction
tools.best_for: Generating production UI code from Figma designs with AI assistants

tools.name: Supabase MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Supabase Postgres databases, schema, migrations, and project management for AI-driven backend work
tools.pricing_paid: Governed by Supabase plan tiers (Pro and above)
strengths: OAuth-secured hosted endpoint
Lets agents query and manage databases safely
Popular in full-stack AI app development
tools.best_for: AI agents managing database schema and querying data in Supabase projects

tools.name: Notion MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Notion pages, databases, and content for reading, searching, and writing knowledge-base data
tools.pricing_paid: Included with Notion plans; usage tied to workspace subscription
strengths: Official OAuth-secured hosted endpoint
Rich knowledge-base read/write for agents
Broad adoption in docs and PM workflows
tools.best_for: Giving agents access to company docs, notes, and structured Notion databases

tools.name: Stripe MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Stripe payments, customers, invoices, and billing operations for AI-assisted commerce workflows
tools.pricing_paid: No MCP fee; standard Stripe transaction fees apply
strengths: OAuth-secured hosted endpoint
Safe, scoped access to payment operations
First-party agent toolkit support
tools.best_for: Automating billing, customer, and payment tasks via AI agents

tools.name: Smithery
tools.connects_to: Registry and marketplace of thousands of MCP servers with one-click install and hosted deployment
tools.pricing_paid: Paid hosting/usage tiers for deployed and managed servers
strengths: Largest discovery registry for MCP servers
One-click configuration for popular clients
Hosted deployment option for any server
tools.best_for: Discovering, installing, and hosting MCP servers quickly

tools.name: Docker MCP (MCP Catalog & Toolkit)
tools.connects_to: Containerized MCP servers run and isolated via Docker, with a curated catalog and gateway routing
tools.pricing_paid: Docker subscription tiers (Pro/Team/Business) for advanced features
strengths: Sandboxed, reproducible server execution in containers
Curated MCP catalog and one-click toolkit
Built-in gateway for secure local/remote access
tools.best_for: Running MCP servers securely in isolated containers with centralized management

tools.name: Slack MCP Server (korotovsky)
tools.connects_to: Slack channels, messages, and users for reading and posting in workspaces via AI agents
strengths: Most widely adopted community Slack MCP (~1,800 GitHub stars)
Actively maintained in 2026
No-admin install options for restricted workspaces
tools.best_for: Letting agents read and send Slack messages across team channels

tools.name: mcp.so
tools.connects_to: Community directory indexing thousands of MCP servers and clients for discovery
strengths: Large, searchable community catalog
Fast way to find niche and new servers
Vendor-neutral discovery hub
tools.best_for: Browsing and discovering the full breadth of available MCP servers

tools.name: Sentry MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Sentry error monitoring, issues, traces, and performance data for AI-assisted debugging
tools.pricing_paid: Included with Sentry plans; usage tied to subscription
strengths: Official OAuth-secured remote endpoint
Surfaces real error/trace context to agents
Strong community recommendation in 2026 surveys
tools.best_for: AI agents triaging and debugging production errors from Sentry data
